user.description: Select the switch entity that controls your boiler relay (circulator). This is the first required step.

weather.description: Select an external temperature or weather sensor to enable weather compensation. This will dynamically adjust the heating logic based on outdoor conditions.

data_description.window_sensor: Automatically bypass the zone when this sensor is open

trv_calibration.title: TRV Configuration (Offset Sensor)
trv_calibration.description: Select the temperature offset (calibration) entities for each TRV in zone {zone_name}. These are usually `number` entities provided by your TRV integration (e.g. Better Thermostat, Z2M, ZHA). If left empty, we will use 'Target Temperature Compensation' (faking the target temp to match the external sensor).

geofencing.title: Geofencing & Smart Schedule
geofencing.description: Do you want to enable Geofencing and Auto-Night mode? If enabled, select a presence sensor (e.g. zone.home or a person entity).
